controles.affirmation: Camden a regle l'action collective RealPage pour 53,0 M$ sans reconnaissance de responsabilite, payable en deux versements de 26,5 M$, le premier verse au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: we agreed to pay an aggregate of $ 53.0 million to settle all claims ... The settlement payment was payable in two equal installments of $ 26.5 million, the first of which was timely paid during the three months ending June 30, 2026 and the second of which is due during the third quarter of 2026 ... did not and does not constitute an admission of fault or liability
controles.correction_proposee: Preciser que le second versement de 26,5 M$ n'est pas encore paye (du au T3 2026) : la preuve de l'ATT dit 'paye en deux versements'.

controles.affirmation: Le procureur general du Maryland a modifie une plainte en cours le 5 juin 2026 pour y ajouter Camden comme defendeur
controles.verbatim_source: On June 5, 2026, the Maryland Attorney General amended a pending lawsuit centering around the use of said revenue management software to add additional defendants, including Camden.

controles.affirmation: Le Department of Justice et dix Etats poursuivent une action civile distincte contre RealPage et ses utilisateurs, dont Camden
controles.verbatim_source: On January 7, 2025, we along with six other owners and/or operators of multifamily housing, were named in a civil lawsuit brought by the U.S. Department of Justice and ten states against RealPage with similar allegations.

controles.affirmation: La societe precise avoir ete informee que d'autres regulateurs d'Etat enquetent sur ce dossier
controles.verbatim_source: Additionally, we have been informed by other state regulators they are investigating this matter.

controles.affirmation: Le BPA dilue est passe de 0,74 $ a 0,18 $ au T2 2026 (-75,7%) ... ce recul provient en grande partie d'une charge Other non-operating expenses de 61,3 M$ liee au reglement RealPage
controles.verbatim_source: Other non-operating expenses 400 2,187 61,305 3,947 (T2 2026 / T2 2025 / S1 2026 / S1 2025) ; During the three months ended March 31, 2026, we recorded aggregate loss contingencies of $ 58.8 million ; Gain on sale of operating property, including land - 47,293 68,100 47,293
controles.correction_proposee: La charge RealPage n'explique PAS la chute du BPA du T2 : le poste Other non-operating expenses n'est que de 0,4 M$ au T2 2026 (61,3 M$ sur le semestre, comptabilises au T1 2026). La chute du T2 vient d'abord de l'absence de plus-value de cession (0 au T2 2026 contre 47,3 M$ au T2 2025). Reformuler : 'le recul du semestre provient en grande partie de la charge de 61,3 M$ passee au premier trimestre 2026 ; celui du seul T2 s'explique surtout par l'absence de plus-value de cession'.
